title: HLSR: Hybrid Live Forecast Selective Dynamic Vehicle Rerouting for Real-Time Congestion Avoidance
abstract: arXiv:2608.18056v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Urban traffic congestion reduces productivity and increases travel cost and emissions. Network-wide live travel-time shortest-path rerouting can be highly effective in simulation, but assumes that essentially every on-road vehicle is replanned every decision period. We propose HLSR, a selective hybrid live--forecast vehicle rerouting framework that fuses live edge speeds with short-horizon forecasts under limited intervention scope. Building on dual-threshold congestion detection, calibrated upstream selection, and driver-tailored travel-time prediction, HLSR further introduces approaching-vehicle expansion, travel-time-weighted k-shortest-path generation, and a horizon-dependent hybrid live--forecast segment speed used in multi-cost route allocation.

translated_title: HLSR：混合实时预测选择性动态车辆重路由以实现实时拥堵规避
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.18056v1 公告类型：新 摘要：城市交通拥堵降低了生产力，增加了出行成本和排放。网络范围内的实时出行时间最短路径重路由在模拟中可能非常有效，但假设每个决策周期内几乎每辆在途车辆都被重新规划。我们提出了HLSR，一种选择性混合实时预测车辆重路由框架，该框架在有限干预范围内融合实时边缘速度与短期预测。基于双阈值拥堵检测、校准的上游选择以及驾驶员定制的出行时间预测，HLSR进一步引入了接近车辆扩展、出行时间加权k最短路径生成，以及用于多成本路径分配的地平线依赖混合实时预测分段速度。
tldr: 本文提出HLSR框架，通过选择性混合实时预测和有限干预范围，在拥堵检测、路径生成和速度预测上创新，实现了高效实时拥堵规避。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes HLSR, a selective hybrid live-forecast rerouting framework that innovates in congestion detection, path generation, and speed prediction to efficiently avoid real-time congestion.
